mapper.sql: r.material_id,r.factory_id,(SELECT factory_name FROM metal_factory WHERE factory_id=r.factory_id) factory_name,r.material_code,r.material_type,r.specification,r.metal_type_id,(SELECT name FROM metal_type WHERE metal_type_id=r.metal_type_id) metal_type_name, (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_inventory i WHERE i.reference_id=r.material_id AND i.category='RAW') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_warehouse_order_line l WHERE l.reference_id=r.material_id AND l.category='RAW') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_work_order_item wi JOIN metal_work_order w ON w.work_order_id=wi.work_order_id WHERE wi.material_id=r.material_id AND w.task_type='RAW_PROCESSING' AND w.del_flag='0') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metal_warehouse_flow_line fl JOIN metal_warehouse_flow_group g ON g.group_id=fl.group_id JOIN metal_warehouse_flow f ON f.flow_id=g.flow_id WHERE f.status IN ('WAITING','COLLECTING','RETURNED') AND g.status<>'SUPERSEDED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fl.line_json,'$.referenceId'))=CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR) AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fl.line_json,'$.category'))='RAW')) classification_locked, r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time,r.version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.factory_id IS NOT NULL AND r.factory_id=#{factoryId} ORDER BY r.material_id ASC
SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.material_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM metal_material r WHERE r.del_flag='0' AND r.material_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE metal_material SET material_code=#{code},material_type=#{materialType},metal_type_id=#{metalTypeId},specification=#{specification},version=version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW() WHERE material_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND del_flag='0'
UPDATE metal_material SET del_flag='2',version=version+1,update_by=#{actor},update_time=NOW() WHERE material_id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
